title: HiER: Highlight Experience Replay for Boosting Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning Agents
review_status: full-text audit complete; eight-task, two-simulator evaluation with ten seeds per task; sim-to-real not evaluated
sections_checked: highlight replay method and threshold/sampling variants
ten-seed evaluation protocol and aggregate confidence intervals
HiER/HiER+ results across Panda-Gym, Fetch and PointMaze
evidence_note: Across eight simulated tasks, SAC+HER baseline IQM success rate 0.56 versus 0.83 with HiER+HER; ten runs per configuration/task and non-overlapping confidence intervals reported. All results use PyBullet or MuJoCo; authors leave sim-to-sim/sim-to-real transfer for future work. Success aggregates use best evaluation score per run, not a final deployed policy.

title: GSON: A Group-based Social Navigation Framework with Large Multimodal Model
review_status: full-text audit complete; physical social-navigation experiments with small repeated-scenario counts and explicit dense-crowd/latency limitations
sections_checked: physical robot navigation protocol and disturbance metrics
evidence_note: On 100 scenes tested ten times/model, GPT-4o has 77.8% exact group accuracy and 86.6% including acceptable omissions. Physical robot scenarios were run three times each; GSON reports lower selected social-disturbance metrics with comparable standard navigation measures. LMM latency is about 1.5-2s in dense scenarios; occlusion and binary group labels are limitations. Some LMM baselines were omitted due closed code or unreliable pilot reproduction.

title: LOVON: Legged Open-Vocabulary Object Navigator
review_status: full-text audit complete; simulation benchmarks plus qualitative/targeted physical Go2 experiments; broad real-world success rate not quantified
sections_checked: motion-blur filter mechanism and threshold study
real-robot examples and Go2 object-search ablation
evidence_note: Gym-Unreal reports 0.99-1.00 success over 100 trials/scene; most real-world examples are demonstrations. On a targeted Go2 ablation, blur filtering plus an extra search state reduces 6m backpack search from 178s to 32.57s. Training set has one million LLM-generated samples; filtering threshold is empirical and can reject valid frames. The paper describes three legged platforms but does not report a repeated multi-robot real-world success-rate protocol.

title: Continue, Abort, or Fall: Viability-Aware Policy Selection (VAPS) for Safe Humanoid Acrobatics
review_status: full-text audit complete; simulation shows safety/task-success Pareto tradeoff and hardware evaluation remains small-sample
sections_checked: nominal/abort/protective-fall specialist policies and viability predictors
LimX Oli full-hierarchy and specialist hardware trials
evidence_note: On randomized-disturbance Unitree G1 simulation, full VAPS reduces head contact 27.7% to 1.6% and hand contact 36.6% to 8.8%, while task success falls 62.1% to 59.6%. LimX Oli full-hierarchy hardware test achieves intended specialist objective on 15/18 trials (83.3%); predictor validation uses 13 side flips. These small hardware counts and one maneuver/platform family do not establish general safety or guarantee no damage.
